args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays), fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affected <2.9.4, fixed in 2.9.4).

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (staying on the 2.x line to minimize upgrade risk)

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**

Requires code-owner approval to merge.
